snippet.title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena | Steam, Playstation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
#QUByteConnect2025

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1064250/Huni_Kuin_Beya_Xin_Bena/

A 2D platform game about the ancient stories of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, who live in the Brazilian Amazon. The entire game was produced in collaboration with the Huni Kuin communities of the Jordão river, in Acre.
